title: music.now_playing
description: Current playback snapshot: { is_playing, track: { name, artist, album, uri, duration_ms } | null, album_art_url (largest album image from the same currently-playing response; null when absent), position_ms, fetched_at_ms, source: 'cache' | 'live' }. Spotify is polled (3s) only while playback is active or was active in the last 60s; when idle, an invocation performs one live read — so the snapshot is always readable on demand with zero standing API traffic at rest. Track changes observed by the poller emit a host_notifications.notify change event (opt-in: only when MUSIC_TOAST=1 is set in env). This is the read path: it NEVER opens the browser grant — with no cached token it denies music_not_authenticated by name (run music.play once to authenticate). No parameters.
